description:
Diff two versions of the same document, computed server-side.

Answers "what changed in v5 vs v4?" without pulling either version's
chunks into this process: the backend diffs on the fly and returns only
the changes, so a 900-page contract costs one small response instead of
two full document loads.

The backend picks the differ from the document's type, so read
``diff_format`` and ``unit`` before interpreting the counts — a
spreadsheet reports changed *cells*, a Word-style document reports
changed *blocks*, and plain text reports *lines*. ``rendered_diff`` is a
unified diff for text and a one-line-per-change list otherwise.

Check ``truncated`` and ``degraded`` before summarizing: a truncated
diff's counts describe only what was returned, and a degraded one means
the backend fell back to a weaker differ. For per-chunk provenance
("where did this sentence come from?") use ``trace_chunk_lineage``.

Note: viewing a diff is a privileged read, so the backend records a
``document.diff.viewed`` audit event — much like downloading the file.

document_id.description: Optional: the owning document, echoed back for your own bookkeeping. Not needed to compute the diff — the server resolves the document from the version id.
document_id.title: Document Id

from_version_id.description: Older / baseline version id (the left side). Omit to diff against the immediate predecessor, which is what 'what changed in the latest version?' usually means.
from_version_id.title: From Version Id

to_version_id.description: Newer / target version id (the right side of the diff).
to_version_id.title: To Version Id

name: compare_versions

outputSchema.description:
Server-computed diff between two versions of one document.

The counts are whatever the backend's differ reports for the document's
native shape, so they are *not* always line counts: a spreadsheet diff
counts cells, a structured (JSON/CSV-ish) diff counts field paths, and a
Word-style document diff counts blocks. ``unit`` names what was counted so
an agent doesn't have to guess.

added.description: Units present only on the right side.
added.title: Added

degraded.description: True when the backend could not run its preferred differ and fell back (e.g. undecodable source). Read ``degraded_reason`` before trusting the diff.
degraded.title: Degraded

degraded_reason.description: Why the diff was degraded, when it was.
degraded_reason.title: Degraded Reason

diff_format.description: Which differ ran, chosen by the backend from the document's type: `text` | `cells` (spreadsheets) | `structured` (JSON/CSV-ish) | `document` (Word-style block diff).
diff_format.title: Diff Format

document_id.description: Echo of the ``document_id`` you passed, if any. The diff endpoint is version-scoped and resolves the document itself, so this is a convenience echo rather than something the server returned.
document_id.title: Document Id

from_version.description: Human-facing version number of the left side.
from_version.title: From Version

from_version_id.description: Older / left version actually diffed. Null when ``to_version_id`` is the document's first version (it is then diffed against empty).
from_version_id.title: From Version Id

modified.description: Units present on both sides with different content.
modified.title: Modified

removed.description: Units present only on the left side.
removed.title: Removed

rendered_diff.description: Human-readable rendering of the changes: a unified diff for `text`, otherwise one line per change. Capped in length; see ``truncated``.
rendered_diff.title: Rendered Diff

summary.description: One-line plain-English summary of the comparison.
summary.title: Summary

to_version.description: Human-facing version number of the right side.
to_version.title: To Version

to_version_id.description: Newer / right version that was diffed.
to_version_id.title: To Version Id

truncated.description: True when the backend capped the diff payload. Counts cover what was returned, not the whole document — do not state totals as final.
truncated.title: Truncated

unit.description: What ``added``/``removed``/``modified`` count: lines, cells, fields or blocks.
unit.title: Unit

outputSchema.title: VersionDiffResult
